brief: Goldman's hedge fund crowding monitor (data through Sep 11, 2026) reports hedge funds tilting bullish across cyclicals and analog semiconductors. Semi & Semi Equipment long crowding held steady at 0.32 (45th percentile) while short crowding eased from 0.54 to 0.31 (70th percentile). Analog Semis long crowding surged from 1.22 to 1.39 (99th percentile) with shorts deeply uncrowded at -0.39 (2nd percentile), a contrast the note reads as funds concentrating bullish bets specifically in analog names rather than semis broadly. Materials long crowding rotated from -0.01 to 0.32 (92nd percentile) as short crowding crossed from crowded to uncrowded (0.06 to -0.08); Metals long crowding rose to 0.54 (66th percentile) from 0.39. Defense long crowding rose to 0.16 (98th percentile) while short crowding fell further into uncrowded territory, from -0.26 to -0.48. Crowding scores are z-scores versus history, roughly -2 to +2; above 0 is crowded, above +1 highly crowded. No trade calls or targets are stated.
